longDescription: Frank Baum is a children's fantasy novel published in 1903. A bored fairy convinces three mortal girls to transform her into a human boy for one year.

authorInfo.bio:
L. Frank (Lyman Frank) Baum (1856–1919) is the author of The Enchanted Island of Yew
Whereon Prince Marvel Encountered the High Ki of Twi and Other Surprising People. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
